record.question: A company files an appeal against an Order on the 25th day after the Order was communicated to them, the Appellate Officer reviews the submitted documents and believes the appeal lacks merit. What must the Appellate Officer do next according to the procedure?
options: Provide the company with an opportunity to be heard before making a final decision
Consult the appropriate government before proceeding with hearing
Dismiss the appeal immediately based on the initial review of the documents
Inform the company that the appeal can only be heard after the 30th day period has expired
